definition.sellingAge: completed history length minus first positive completed sales index; current WTD excluded
definition.sellingAgeVelocity: same normalized [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4] recency weights over up to four selling-age completed weeks
definition.existingVelocity: sku-sync weighted4CompletedWeekQty over last four completed calendar rows, including pre-launch zeros
definition.materialRules: relative velocity difference >=25%; relative cover difference >=25%
definition.analogPace: independent existing Analog Pace percentile, shown only for W2-W8
